task: B-2 Gemini 3 系 API 仕様の web_fetch 確認

temperature.prompt_claimed: Gemini 3 系は default 1.0 推奨、0.3 だと looping / degraded performance の可能性
temperature.official_quote_recommend: we strongly recommend keeping the temperature parameter at its default value of `1.0`.
temperature.official_quote_warning: Changing the temperature (setting it below 1.0) may lead to unexpected behavior, such as looping or degraded performance
temperature.implication: C-2 で Gemini 3 系には temperature を渡さない (default 1.0 維持) 設計が公式推奨と一致

thinking_level_vs_budget.prompt_claimed: thinking_level / thinking_budget 同時指定で 400 error
thinking_level_vs_budget.official_quote: You cannot use both `thinking_level` and the legacy `thinking_budget` parameter in the same request. Doing so will return a 400 error.
thinking_level_vs_budget.implication: 本バッチでは布陣表から外す (改修なし、PoC 確認項目)。Hydrangea 本番パスは generation_config に thinking_* を渡していない (前バッチ F-gemini-3.5-flash-api-audit で 0 件確認済)

supported_features.official_quote: Gemini 3 models allow you to combine [Structured Outputs] with built-in tools, including [Grounding with Google Search]
supported_features.implication: JP coverage の Grounding (gemini-2.5-flash 経由) を将来 3 系に上げても grounding は supported。本バッチでは grounding model は変更しない
